description: Dev Harness - Multi-Agent Task Management System. A Dockerised kanban board with FastAPI backend, TypeScript frontend, SQLite database, and Redis event broker for autonomous multi-agent software development workflows.

userStories.title: Project scaffold and Docker Compose setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project structure, Docker Compose configuration, and base dependencies set up so all services can run with a single command.
acceptanceCriteria: Create project directory structure: frontend/, backend/, with docker-compose.yml at root
docker-compose.yml defines 4 services: frontend (nginx), backend (FastAPI), redis, and a SQLite volume mount
Backend service runs FastAPI on port 9080 (configurable via PORT env var)
Frontend service serves static files via nginx
Redis service starts and is reachable from backend
.env.example file documents all required environment variables
.gitignore excludes progress.txt, ralph.log, .env, __pycache__, node_modules
docker-compose up starts all services without errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: FastAPI backend base with config loading
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the FastAPI app skeleton with config loading from config.json and environment variables.
acceptanceCriteria: FastAPI app initialises with CORS middleware
Config loads from config.json in project root (if present), with env var overrides

Config supports: PORT (default 9080), agent timeouts per type (developer 20min, reviewer 10min, tester 10min, merger 5min), max_agents_system (default 10), max_agents_per_column (default 10), review_rejection_threshold (default 3)
GET /api/health endpoint returns {status: ok}
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: SQLite database setup and migrations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the SQLite database schema created with all required tables.
acceptanceCriteria: SQLAlchemy (or Tortoise ORM) configured with SQLite

Tickets table created with fields: id, project, title, description, acceptance_criteria (JSON), priority, state, branch_name, worktree_path, current_agent, assigned_at, agent_attempts, developer_timeouts, reviewer_timeouts, tester_timeouts, merger_timeouts, review_rejection_count, created_at, updated_at
State field supports: to_do, in_progress, ready_for_review, in_review, ready_for_test, in_test, ready_to_merge, done, blocked
Notes table created with fields: id, ticket_id (FK), author, content, note_type, created_at
Note type supports: progress, failure, review, test_result, general
Events table created with fields: id, ticket_id (FK), event_type, previous_state, new_state, agent_id, payload (JSON), created_at
Agent registry table created with fields: id, agent_type, status (available/busy), current_ticket_id, started_at
Settings table created with fields: key, value, updated_at
Ticket dependencies table created with fields: id, ticket_id (FK), depends_on_ticket_id (FK), created_at
Database migrations run successfully on startup
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ticket CRUD API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need REST API endpoints to create, read, update, and delete tickets.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/tickets creates a ticket with required fields (project, title, description, acceptance_criteria, priority)
GET /api/tickets returns all tickets, filterable by project and state query params
GET /api/tickets/{id} returns a single ticket with its notes
PATCH /api/tickets/{id} updates ticket fields
DELETE /api/tickets/{id} deletes a ticket
All responses use consistent JSON schema
Unit tests for all CRUD operations
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ticket dependency management API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API endpoints to manage ticket dependencies with cycle detection.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/tickets/{id}/dependencies adds a dependency (depends_on_ticket_id)
DELETE /api/tickets/{id}/dependencies/{dep_id} removes a dependency
GET /api/tickets/{id}/dependencies returns blocked_by and blocks arrays derived from ticket_dependencies table
Cycle detection runs on POST — returns 400 error if circular dependency detected
Blocked tickets (with unresolved hard dependencies) cannot transition past to_do state
Unit tests for dependency creation, deletion, and cycle detection
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Notes and comments API
userStories.description: As an agent or user, I need to add and retrieve timestamped notes on tickets.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/tickets/{id}/notes creates a note with fields: author, content, note_type
GET /api/tickets/{id}/notes returns notes ordered by created_at descending
Note content supports plain text (markdown rendered in UI)
Unit tests for note creation and retrieval
Golden path e2e test: create ticket, add 3 notes, verify order
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: State transition API with validation
userStories.description: As a system, I need a validated state transition endpoint that enforces workflow rules.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/tickets/{id}/transition accepts {new_state, agent_id, note} payload
Validates allowed transitions: to_do → in_progress → ready_for_review → in_review → ready_for_test → in_test → ready_to_merge → done
Any state can transition to blocked
Blocked tickets cannot transition without manual override flag
Prevents transition to in_progress if hard dependencies not in done state
Auto-generates a note on every state transition
Publishes state_change event to Redis channel ticket:events
Unit tests for valid and invalid transitions
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Redis event publisher and subscriber
userStories.description: As a system, I need Redis Pub/Sub wired up for agent coordination and UI broadcasting.
acceptanceCriteria: Redis client initialised in FastAPI on startup
publish_event(channel, event) helper publishes JSON events to Redis
subscribe_events() async generator subscribes to ticket:events channel
Events include: ticket_state_changed, agent_assigned, agent_completed, agent_failed, ticket_blocked
Event payload includes: event_type, ticket_id, previous_state, new_state, agent_id, timestamp
Unit tests for publish and subscribe
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: WebSocket endpoint for real-time board updates
userStories.description: As a UI client, I need a WebSocket connection to receive live board updates.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /ws WebSocket endpoint accepts connections
FastAPI subscribes to Redis ticket:events and broadcasts to all connected WebSocket clients
Connection status tracked, stale connections cleaned up
Auto-reconnect handled client-side
Unit tests for WebSocket message handling
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Git worktree management service
userStories.description: As a system, I need a service to create and delete git worktrees for each ticket.
acceptanceCriteria: create_worktree(ticket_id, project_path) creates a git worktree branched from main, branch named ticket/{ticket_id}
Worktree path stored on ticket as worktree_path, branch name as branch_name
delete_worktree(ticket_id) deletes the worktree and branch after merge
progress.txt and ralph.log added to .gitignore in worktree
AGENTS.md from main is present in worktree
Error handling for missing project path or git failures
Unit tests for worktree creation and deletion
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Agent type definitions and prompt loading
userStories.description: As a system, I need agent type configurations with prompts loaded from files.
acceptanceCriteria: Define 4 agent types: developer, reviewer, tester, merger
Developer prompt loaded from /home/henry/Projects/my-ralph-template/prompt.md
Reviewer, tester, merger prompts loaded from configurable paths (defaulting to backend/prompts/{type}.md)
Fallback placeholder prompts created for reviewer, tester, merger if files don't exist
Agent type config includes: column binding, timeout, prompt path
Column bindings: developer→to_do, reviewer→ready_for_review, tester→ready_for_test, merger→ready_to_merge
Unit tests for prompt loading and agent config validation
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Agent pickup and locking system
userStories.description: As an agent, I need to claim a ticket with distributed locking to prevent concurrent pickup.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/agents/pickup/{agent_type} finds the next available ticket for that agent type
Uses Redis distributed lock (SET NX EX) to prevent concurrent pickup of same ticket
Prioritises tickets from the active priority project
Enforces system-wide agent cap (default 10) — returns 429 if at capacity
WIP reduction priority: merger > tester > reviewer > developer when near cap
Increments agent_attempts on pickup
Updates ticket state to in_progress (or in_review / in_test as appropriate)
Registers agent in agent registry
Unit tests for pickup logic including concurrency and cap enforcement
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Agent completion and failure flow
userStories.description: As an agent, I need to report task completion or failure and trigger appropriate state transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/agents/complete/{ticket_id} marks work as successful, advances ticket to next state, releases agent lock
POST /api/agents/fail/{ticket_id} accepts {reason, suggested_fixes} payload
On failure: adds failure note to ticket, increments review_rejection_count if from reviewer, returns ticket to to_do
If review_rejection_count reaches threshold (default 3): moves ticket to blocked, publishes ticket_blocked event, alerts via Henry notification
Timeout detection: background task checks agent_registry for tickets assigned longer than agent type timeout, releases lock and increments appropriate timeout counter
Agent status updated to available on completion/failure/timeout
Unit tests for success, failure, and timeout paths
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ralph loop integration for agent execution
userStories.description: As a system, I need to spawn a ralph loop process for each agent task in the ticket's worktree.
acceptanceCriteria: spawn_agent(ticket, agent_type) runs ralph binary in ticket's worktree with correct prompt and timeout
Agent receives ticket context: title, description, acceptance criteria, previous notes as part of prd.json in worktree
ralph runs with -timeout flag matching agent type timeout config
On ralph process exit: success calls /api/agents/complete, failure calls /api/agents/fail
progress.txt and ralph.log created in worktree, not committed
Unit tests for agent spawn and result handling
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ralph prd.json import API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to import an existing Ralph prd.json file to create board tickets.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/projects/import accepts {project_name, prd_path} payload
Reads prd.json from given path, converts user stories to tickets
Maps Ralph fields: id→id, title→title, description→description, acceptanceCriteria→acceptance_criteria, priority→priority
Sets project field to project_name (folder name)
All imported tickets start in to_do state
Returns count of imported tickets
Unit tests for import with sample Ralph prd.json
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Settings API
userStories.description: As a user, I need API endpoints to read and update system settings.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/settings returns all current settings
PATCH /api/settings updates one or more settings values
Settings include: agent timeouts per type, max_agents_system, max_agents_per_column, review_rejection_threshold, active_priority_project
config.json values take precedence over database settings on startup
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: TypeScript frontend scaffold
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the frontend project scaffolded with Vite and TypeScript.
acceptanceCriteria: Vite + TypeScript project initialised in frontend/
API client utility configured to call backend at /api
WebSocket client utility with auto-reconnect
Base CSS with professional styling variables
npm run build produces dist/ for nginx
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Kanban board UI — columns and ticket cards
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all 9 columns with tickets displayed as cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders 9 columns: To Do, In Progress, Ready for Review, In Review, Ready for Test, In Test, Ready to Merge, Done, Blocked
Each column shows ticket count badge
Ticket cards show: title, priority badge, project name, assigned agent, dependency count
Blocked column visually distinct (e.g. red border)
Responsive layout works on desktop and tablet
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Real-time board updates via WebSocket
userStories.description: As a user, I want the board to update live when tickets change state.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend connects to /ws on load
State change events update ticket card position without page refresh
Connection status indicator shown (connected/reconnecting)
Auto-reconnects on disconnect
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Ticket detail panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to click a ticket card to see full details, notes, and history.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a ticket card opens a side panel or modal
Shows: title, description, acceptance criteria (with checkboxes), state, priority, project, branch name
Shows agent attempt counts and timeout counts per type
Shows review_rejection_count
Shows notes in reverse chronological order
Shows dependency list (blocked_by / blocks)
Close button dismisses panel
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Manual drag-and-drop state changes
userStories.description: As a user, I want to drag tickets between columns to manually override state.
acceptanceCriteria: Tickets are draggable between columns
Invalid transitions prevented with visual feedback
On drop: calls POST /api/tickets/{id}/transition with manual_override flag
Auto-generates note: 'Manually moved from X to Y by user'
Visual ghost card during drag
Undo button appears for 5 seconds after drop
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Admin dashboard — agent monitor and metrics
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dashboard showing active agents, workflow metrics, and system health.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard page accessible at /dashboard
Shows active agents: agent_id, type, current ticket, time elapsed
Shows workflow metrics: ticket count per column, average time per state
Shows timeout analytics: timeout counts per agent type aggregated across all tickets
Shows failed/blocked tickets with rejection counts
Manual controls: force unlock stuck ticket button, pause/resume all agents toggle
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Settings panel in admin dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to adjust system settings from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings section in dashboard shows all current config values
Editable fields: agent timeouts per type, max_agents_system, review_rejection_threshold, active_priority_project
Save button calls PATCH /api/settings
Changes take effect immediately without restart
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Dependency visualisation on board
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see which tickets are blocked by dependencies on the board.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked-by-dependency tickets show a lock icon on their card
Tooltip on lock icon lists the blocking ticket IDs
Automatic unblocking: when a dependency moves to done, dependent ticket lock icon removed
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Henry alert notifications for blocked tickets
userStories.description: As Henry, I need to be alerted when a ticket is escalated to blocked so I can notify Derrick.
acceptanceCriteria: When ticket moves to blocked state, publish ticket_blocked event to Redis
Notification service subscribes to ticket_blocked events
Sends alert via OpenClaw (or logs to a notifications file if OpenClaw not available)
Alert message includes: ticket id, title, project, review_rejection_count, last failure note
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Project management — import and priority
userStories.description: As a user, I want to import Ralph projects and set the active priority project.
acceptanceCriteria: Import project form: input for project name and prd.json path, calls POST /api/projects/import
Project list shows all projects with ticket counts
Set active priority project button updates settings
Active priority project visually highlighted on board (filter by project dropdown)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: End-to-end golden path test
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a full end-to-end test verifying the complete agent workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: E2e test: import a sample prd.json, verify tickets created in to_do
Simulate developer agent pickup: ticket moves to in_progress, worktree created
Simulate developer completion: ticket moves to ready_for_review
Simulate reviewer failure: ticket returns to to_do with failure note, review_rejection_count incremented
Simulate 3 review rejections: ticket moves to blocked, alert triggered
Simulate merger success: ticket moves to done, worktree deleted
All state changes reflected via WebSocket in UI
Typecheck passes
